texto: Notes the distinction between **rifiuti indifferenziati** (non-separate waste) and **raccolta differenziata** (selective collection or recycling).
It identifies what advantages the favourable neighbours value and what difficulties the night workers point out.

frases.it: Da gennaio il Comune di Parma ha introdotto la raccolta differenziata porta a porta.
frases.es: Desde enero el ayuntamiento de Parma introdujo la recogida selectiva puerta a puerta.
frases.en: Since January, the city of Parma has introduced the selective collection door-to-door.

frases.it: Nei primi sei mesi i rifiuti indifferenziati sono diminuiti del dodici per cento.
frases.es: En los primeros seis meses los residuos no separados disminuyeron un doce por ciento.
frases.en: In the first six months, non-separated waste decreased by 12 per cent.

frases.it: Il progetto prevede contenitori più piccoli e un calendario diverso per ogni zona.
frases.es: El proyecto prevé contenedores más pequeños y un calendario diferente para cada zona.
frases.en: The project provides for smaller containers and a different calendar for each area.

frases.it: Alcuni residenti apprezzano la riduzione dei cassonetti in strada.
frases.es: Algunos residentes aprecian la reducción de los contenedores en la calle.
frases.en: Some residents appreciate the reduction of the containers on the street.

frases.it: Altri residenti segnalano che gli orari serali sono scomodi per chi lavora di notte.
frases.es: Otros residentes señalan que los horarios de tarde son incómodos para quien trabaja de noche.
frases.en: Other residents point out that late hours are uncomfortable for those who work at night.
analisis: for those who work at night

frases.it: Il Comune promette di valutare i risultati prima di estendere il servizio a tutti i quartieri.
frases.es: El ayuntamiento promete evaluar los resultados antes de extender el servicio a todos los barrios.
frases.en: The city council promises to evaluate the results before extending the service to all the neighborhoods.
analisis: il Comune promette di valutare i risultati
the city promises to evaluate the results

bloques.pregunta: What collection system introduced the municipality of Parma in January?

opciones.texto: The selective collection of door-to-door waste in the selected neighbourhoods.
opciones.explicacion: The text specifies: «ha introdotto la raccolta differenziata porta a porta».

opciones.texto: La supresión definitiva del reciclaje para abaratar los costes de transporte.
opciones.explicacion: The project promotes selective collection and waste reduction.

opciones.texto: The obligation to take the waste to treatment plants outside the province.
opciones.explicacion: The service is done directly door-to-door in the houses.

bloques.pregunta: What statistical result was achieved during the first six months?

opciones.texto: Unseparated waste experienced a 12 per cent reduction.
opciones.explicacion: The news says «i rifiuti indifferenziati sono diminuiti del dodici per cento».

opciones.texto: El volumen de basuras aumentó notablemente por falta de contenedores.
opciones.explicacion: There was a verified reduction, not an increase in waste.

opciones.texto: No data could be recorded because the meters were broken.
opciones.explicacion: The administration published specific comparative data.

bloques.pregunta: What positive aspect is highlighted by several citizens of the new plan?

opciones.texto: La disminución visible de grandes contenedores acumulados en las calles públicas.
opciones.explicacion: They appreciate «la riduzione dei cassonetti in strada», which improves the urban space.

opciones.texto: The city council has abolished all taxes on the collection.
opciones.explicacion: The text does not mention tax exemptions, but visual cleaning on the tracks.

opciones.texto: Allow any type of waste to be deposited at any time of the day.
opciones.explicacion: The system requires the following of area-specific timetables.

bloques.pregunta: What inconvenience do other neighbours express about the new system?

opciones.texto: That the fixed hours are unpractical for those who have night work shifts.
opciones.explicacion: They complain that «gli orari serali sono scomodi per chi lavora di notte».

opciones.texto: Que los contenedores individuales resultan excesivamente pesados para transportarlos.
opciones.explicacion: The objection focuses on the night deposit hours, not on weight.

opciones.texto: That collection is only done twice a year during the summer.
opciones.explicacion: The service follows a weekly periodic calendar.

bloques.pregunta: What commitment does the city take before extending the service?

opciones.texto: Evaluar minuciosamente las observaciones de los ciudadanos y los resultados provisionales.
opciones.explicacion: The text states: «promette di valutare i risultati prima di estendere il servizio».

opciones.texto: To impose immediate sanctions on those neighbours who do not share the initiative.
opciones.explicacion: The municipality chooses to evaluate the experience and listen to suggestions.

opciones.texto: Cancel the selective collection project irrevocably in the autumn.
opciones.explicacion: The objective announced is to improve the service and expand it to more neighborhoods.

bloques.pregunta: What does this phrase reveal about the impact of the programme?
bloques.frase: I rifiuti indifferenziati sono diminuiti del dodici per cento nei primi sei mesi.

opciones.texto: That citizens better separate their waste and generate less generic garbage.
opciones.explicacion: Less undifferentiated waste shows greater efficiency in domestic recycling.

opciones.texto: That the city's population was reduced by 12 percent during the winter.
opciones.explicacion: The percentage concerns strictly the tonnage of collected waste.

opciones.texto: That the economic cost of the service doubled in half a year of application.
opciones.explicacion: The figure measures the physical amount of garbage, not the municipal budget.

bloques.frase: Il Comune intende ___ le osservazioni dei residenti prima di ampliare il piano.

opciones.texto: valutare
opciones.explicacion: The first conjugation to judge or weigh results.

opciones.texto: valuta
opciones.explicacion: He is the third person of singular in the present indicative.

opciones.texto: valutato
opciones.explicacion: It's the isolated past participle.

intro: Read this information article on environmental management in the city of Parma. It examines how the measures taken, the statistics achieved and the public's assessments are presented.
